title: Isha Ponti releases debut album ‘LIKAS’ on limited-edition vinyl

blocks.text: Singer-songwriter Isha Ponti has released a limited-edition vinyl record of her debut album, “LIKAS,” marking her first release in the long-playing (LP) format. Released by Ponti Entertainment Production, the special-edition vinyl features the album’s 10 original tracks, all written by Ponti herself. “LIKAS” explores five themes reflected in its title: Longing, Illusion, Kindness, Acceptance, and Self-Love. The album draws from Ponti’s personal experiences as a young singer-songwriter. The vinyl release offers fans another way to experience the album, which was previously made available in digital format.
